summary:
聯合健康EPS超預期9.5%顯示獲利修復，但營收年增僅2%反映成長明顯降速。
• EPS 7.23美元，超出預期6.60美元，超預期幅度9.52%
• 營收1117.2億美元，規模龐大但年增僅1.96%，成長放緩
• 獲利超預期反映醫療成本率（MLR）管理改善與營運修復
• Optum與保險雙引擎仍提供現金流穩定性
ai_view:
訊號好壞參半：EPS大幅超預期反映醫療成本控管與獲利修復，但營收年增僅2%顯示成長引擎放緩，市場將聚焦「獲利改善能否持續」對「成長停滯」的拉鋸。短期股價對成本率（MLR）改善反應正面，中期須觀察Medicare Advantage給付與會員成長。追蹤指標：醫療成本率、會員數、Optum營收成長、全年EPS指引與監管動向。

需留意：營收年增僅2%，成長動能顯著減弱；醫療成本通膨與Medicare Advantage給付政策為長期逆風；監管審查與訴訟風險、產業聲譽議題仍待消化

summary_en:
UnitedHealth beat EPS by 9.5% showing margin repair, but 2% revenue growth signals a marked slowdown.
• EPS of $7.23 beat the $6.60 estimate by 9.52%
• Revenue of $111.72B is massive but grew only 1.96%, a clear slowdown
• The earnings beat reflects improved medical loss ratio management and operational repair
• Optum and the insurance segment still provide cash-flow stability

ai_view_en:
Signal is mixed: the large EPS beat reflects medical-cost control and margin repair, but 2% revenue growth shows the growth engine slowing, so the market will weigh sustainable margin improvement against stalled growth. Near-term the stock should respond positively to MLR improvement; mid-term watch Medicare Advantage reimbursement and membership growth. Track: medical loss ratio, membership, Optum revenue growth, full-year EPS guidance and regulatory developments.

Watch：Revenue grew only 2%, a meaningful loss of growth momentum; Medical-cost inflation and Medicare Advantage reimbursement policy are long-term headwinds; Regulatory scrutiny, litigation and reputational issues remain to be digested
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期9.52%，惟營收年增僅1.96%，獲利改善但成長趨緩。
